name: app.frontierstack/frontierstack
title: FrontierStack by Enfour, Inc.
description: Enfour, Inc. FrontierStack (www.frontierstack.app): Mac and server health, logs, restarts.

tools.name: list_frontierstack_macs
tools.description: List the FrontierStack Macs connected to this account, whether each is online, its app version, and its mac_id.

tools.name: get_server_health
tools.description: Read operational health from a selected FrontierStack Mac: services, monitors, disks, certificates and alerts it watches.

mac_id.description: Opaque id of one of this account's FrontierStack Macs. Optional only when exactly one Mac is online.

area.description: overall (default): the Local Health board of everything the Mac monitors. queues: sanitized backlog counters for configured message brokers, streams, task queues and cloud queues (never message bodies).

tools.name: get_fleet_context
tools.description: Return the selected Mac’s secret-redacted map of servers, roles, services, network locations and operating conventions, including the names of its linked servers.

mac_id.description: Opaque id of one of this account's FrontierStack Macs. Optional only when exactly one Mac is online.

tools.name: get_alert_errors
tools.description: List outstanding alert and report delivery errors (email, Slack, SMS, push and similar) with likely causes and fixes.

mac_id.description: Opaque id of one of this account's FrontierStack Macs. Optional only when exactly one Mac is online.

tools.name: diagnose
tools.description: Run one bounded, read-only diagnostic program on the selected Mac or a linked server. Arguments are passed directly, never through a shell, and time limits are applied. argv[0] must be one of: ping, ping6, dig, nslookup, host, traceroute, nc (with -z), curl (GET/HEAD), ifconfig, netstat, route, arp, ipconfig (get* only), networksetup (read-only queries), scutil, sysctl, df, uptime, vm_stat, uname, sw_vers, brew (list/info/services list), apachectl configtest, nginx -t, php (-v/-m/-i/--ini/-l), php-config; on Linux targets also nvme, iscsiadm, lsscsi, multipath -ll and InfiniBand status tools. ["oclp"] returns a macOS update-safety report for Macs using OpenCore Legacy Patcher. Anything else is refused by the Mac.

mac_id.description: Opaque id of one of this account's FrontierStack Macs. Optional only when exactly one Mac is online.

target.description: Optional linked server, by the name or host FrontierStack knows it by, to run on over SSH. Omit for the selected Mac itself.

tools.name: read_logs
tools.description: Read a bounded tail of a log on the selected Mac or a linked server. Secrets are removed before the text leaves the Mac.

mac_id.description: Opaque id of one of this account's FrontierStack Macs. Optional only when exactly one Mac is online.

source.description: Which log: "os" (the system log), "wifi" (Wi-Fi events), a service name ("nginx", "apache", "mysql", "postgres", "redis", "sshd", "docker", "php-fpm", "postfix"), "vhost:example.com" for one website's access and error logs, "frontierstack" (the app's own log), or "path:/var/log/file.log".

target.description: Optional linked server, by the name or host FrontierStack knows it by, to run on over SSH. Omit for the selected Mac itself.

lines.description: How many lines from the end. Default 200.

tools.name: service_action
tools.description: Check, start, stop or restart one supported Homebrew web service on the selected Mac. status is read-only; stop and restart interrupt the service. Changes run only if the owner allowed changes on that Mac, and may wait for the owner's approval there. In an unattended run, set queue_for_approval (with reason and observed) so the owner can approve later and the Mac runs it.

mac_id.description: Opaque id of one of this account's FrontierStack Macs. Optional only when exactly one Mac is online.

action.description: status only reads; the others change the service.

queue_for_approval.description: For unattended runs (scheduled or background tasks): instead of running now, queue this start, stop or restart for the owner, who approves it on their phone or Mac; FrontierStack then re-checks and runs it itself. Answers at once with the queued request; do not call again.

reason.description: With queue_for_approval: why the change is needed, in a sentence the owner reads before approving.

observed.description: With queue_for_approval: what you saw that led to it (for example the health result).

tools.name: replace_credential
tools.description: Ask the owner to type a new value for one of the selected Mac’s stored credentials (an API key or token FrontierStack keeps, such as openai, anthropic, cloudflare or stripe) on a secure FrontierStack page, for example after a key has leaked. The value goes from the owner’s browser straight to the Mac, sealed to it and confirmed with a passkey the Mac created; it never passes through the AI client or the conversation, and this tool neither accepts nor returns it. The first call returns a link for the owner (a URL elicitation where the client supports it) with a short code they can compare; a repeat call with the same arguments returns the outcome once they have finished. Requires web approvals and credential entry to be turned on for that Mac.

mac_id.description: Opaque id of one of this account's FrontierStack Macs. Optional only when exactly one Mac is online.

service.description: The credential to replace: its FrontierStack id (for example openai, anthropic, cloudflare, stripe, github) or the service name.

reason.description: Why, in a few words, shown to the owner on the page (for example "the key was pasted into a chat").
